name: Validate DevBob Infrastructure
description: Validates that DevBob multi-container environment is properly configured with working ACP delegation, database persistence, and cross-container coordination

tasks.description: Verify all DevBob containers are running and healthy

prompt.template:
Check that all DevBob infrastructure containers are running and healthy:

Run these commands and report results:
```bash
docker ps --filter name=devbob --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
docker ps --filter name=metabob-redis --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
docker ps --filter name=api-server-dev --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
docker ps --filter name=metabob-surrealdb --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
```

Expected: 8 containers total
- 4 DevBob agents (devbob-rpc-api, devbob-dashboard, devbob-cli, devbob-opencode)
- 4 Backend services (redis, api-server, worker, surrealdb)

Validation: Mark as PASS if all containers are running. Mark as FAIL if any container is missing or unhealthy.

tasks.description: Verify container configurations have correct model and API URLs

prompt.template:
Verify DevBob containers have proper configuration:

For devbob-opencode container, run:
```bash
docker exec devbob-opencode cat /workspace/.opencode/opencode.json | jq '{model, metabob_base_url: .metabob.base_url, has_anthropic: (.provider.anthropic | length > 0)}'
```

Validation criteria:
- model field must be set (e.g. "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514")
- metabob.base_url must be "http://api-server-dev:80"
- At least one provider (anthropic or openai) configured

Mark as PASS if all criteria met. Mark as FAIL if model missing or API URL wrong.

tasks.description: Test that ACP endpoints respond without errors (CRITICAL TEST)

prompt.template:
Test ACP endpoints for all DevBob containers:

Run these commands:
```bash
echo 'Testing devbob-opencode:'
curl -s http://localhost:3004/acp/sessions
echo ''
echo 'Testing devbob-rpc-api:'
curl -s http://localhost:3001/acp/sessions
echo ''
echo 'Testing devbob-cli:'
curl -s http://localhost:3003/acp/sessions
```

Expected response: JSON array like [] or list of sessions
ERROR response: {"name":"UnknownError","data":{"message":"Error:..."}}

This is the CRITICAL test. ACP must work for delegation.

Mark as PASS if all endpoints return valid JSON arrays.
Mark as FAIL if any endpoint returns error or 500 status.

If this fails, delegation is broken and must be fixed.

tasks.description: Test basic ACP delegation to verify end-to-end workflow

prompt.template:
Test a simple ACP delegation to devbob-opencode:

Use the acp_delegate tool:
```
acp_delegate({
  target: "docker://devbob-opencode",
  taskDescription: "List workspace files",
  prompt: "Run 'ls -la /workspace' and show the top 10 files",
  timeout: 60
})
```

Expected: Delegation succeeds and returns file listing
Error: Connection refused, timeout, or error message

Mark as PASS if delegation completes and returns actual file list.
Mark as FAIL if delegation fails, times out, or returns error.

This tests the FULL ACP pipeline end-to-end.

Verify database persistence:

Run these commands:
```bash
# Check volumes exist
docker volume ls | grep devbob | grep -E '(redis|surrealdb|workspace)'

# Test Redis
docker exec metabob-redis redis-cli PING

# Test SurrealDB (if healthy)
curl -s http://localhost:8000/health || echo 'SurrealDB not accessible'
```

Expected:
- At least 6 devbob volumes (redis, surrealdb, 4x workspaces)
- Redis returns PONG
- SurrealDB health endpoint works

Mark as PASS if volumes exist and databases respond.
Mark as FAIL if volumes missing or databases not accessible.

tasks.description: Verify Metabob RPC API backend is accessible

prompt.template:
Verify Metabob RPC API backend:

Run these commands:
```bash
# Test external access (host)
curl -s http://localhost:8080/ | jq -r '.version'

# Test internal access (from container)
docker exec devbob-opencode curl -s http://api-server-dev:80/ | jq -r '.version'
```

Expected: Both return version number (e.g. "0.12.1")

This verifies:
- External access via port 8080
- Internal Docker network access via port 80
- Containers can reach backend API

Mark as PASS if both commands return version.
Mark as FAIL if API not accessible from either location.
